description: Audit record counts by stage in a short window
sql:
SELECT stage, COUNT(*) AS records
      FROM auto_trader_audit
      WHERE timestamp >= :since_ms
        AND timestamp < :until_ms
      GROUP BY stage
      ORDER BY records DESC
limitations: Do not combine local and runtime results
Do not assume paper/live mode from table names
execution_plan: SEARCH auto_trader_audit USING INDEX auto_trader_audit_timestamp (timestamp>? AND timestamp<?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
